text: なかなか…　うまく　いかん　もの　じゃ

structure.jp: うまく　いかん　もの　じゃ

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.span: いかん　もの　じゃ
patterns.explanation: ものだ after a statement says 'that is how things are'. じゃ is the old-man form of だ. いかん　もの　じゃ = 'that's how it is, things don't go well'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is an old-man or dialect form of ない, 'not'. いかん = いかない = 'doesn't go'.

patterns.name: なかなか〜ない
patterns.span: なかなか…　うまく　いかん
patterns.explanation: なかなか together with a 'not' verb means 'not easily, however you try'. なかなか…　うまく　いかん = 'it just doesn't go well easily'.
